d:
Beijing was once among the world's most polluted cities, with AQI readings crossing 700. Today, its air quality has improved dramatically. So what did China do differently?
In this video, we break down 10 strategies China used to tackle air pollution — from holding officials accountable and shutting down polluting factories to cleaner fuels, better public transport, strict pollution monitoring, and public participation.
More importantly, we explore what India can learn from Beijing's transformation and why implementing existing rules matters more than simply announcing new policies.
